description: Gemini client, same-format passthrough, non-stream: an upstream that blocks the prompt (promptFeedback with a blockReason and no candidates) answers 200, and that reply reaches the client unchanged; today's core turns it into a 502.
source: core/internal/runtime/executor/gemini_executor.go:503-547 (prompt feedback with blockReason and no candidates becomes HTTP 502)

exceptions.reason: The new core passes the upstream's reply through unchanged, as it does every same-format reply: a 200 with promptFeedback.blockReason and no candidates, which Gemini clients read as a blocked prompt. Today's core turns it into a 502 with its own error body.

A request in the upstream's own format passes through unchanged (the plan's same-format passthrough). Today's core rewrites it: it adds model and default safetySettings that turn every filter off, renames functionDeclarations to function_declarations, parameters to parametersJsonSchema and responseSchema to responseJsonSchema, fills in empty functionResponse names, and replaces each thoughtSignature with skip_thought_signature_validator, which throws away the model's reasoning state. The new core keeps every thought signature on the part it came with.
